held_setpoints.polymer: linear UHMWPE, target Mn 1.5e6 and Mw 3.0e6 g/mol
held_setpoints.solvent_extraction: n-hexane, then dry; duration and residual oil/hexane must be recorded

required_batch_record: resin identity, measured Mn/Mw and polydispersity
solution dissolution time and measured viscosity
spinneret bore and length, extrusion pressure and throughput
quench residence, extraction duration and solvent residue
actual draw ratio, zone temperature, drawing stress and line speed
single filament diameter distribution and bundle packing
failure location and microscopy of defects
minimum_measurements: single-filament and bundle raw force-extension curves at fixed, reported gauge and strain rate
peak engineering stress using measured load-bearing area
strain at break and toughness by trapezoidal integration to break
more than 10000 cycles at declared service load
knot and actual anchor retention efficiency
decision_logic: Promote only the tested draw-ratio group's exact recorded formulation and process after matching evidence for every target. Changes to the frozen design setpoints require a new candidate design hash; changes to recorded batch conditions require a protocol amendment and separate analysis.
interphase_trigger: Only investigate an interphase after measured slip or bundle load-transfer loss; it does not substitute for filament strength or strain.
